title: Corporate Partnership Executive
description:
STEM Learning Pvt. Ltd. is a leading Pan-India education company that partners with corporates to design and implement impactful CSR initiatives in the education sector. We work towards creating meaningful social impact by transforming classrooms through hands-on STEM programs, Mini Science Labs and teacher training. Our solutions help companies effectively utilize their CSR funds while improving learning outcomes and promoting innovation-driven education across schools and communities.

**Job Title: Business Development Executive/Corporate Partnership Executive**   
**Office Location: B404, B wing, 4th Floor, Amrapali Lakeview Building, Vastrapur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat-380015**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and self-motivated Business Development Executive who will be responsible for acquiring corporate clients, building strong relationships and driving CSR funding/business for our education initiatives. The role involves B2B field sales, corporate meetings, proposal presentations and closing deals to achieve business growth and organizational targets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Identify, approach and build relationships with corporate organizations for CSR partnerships.
* Generate new business by acquiring corporate clients and securing CSR funding for our projects.
* Conduct field visits, meetings and presentations with corporate decision-makers such as CSR Heads, HR Heads, Sustainability Teams, etc.
* Understand the CSR objectives of corporates and present suitable project proposals.
* Negotiate, close deals and ensure timely commitment of CSR funds.
* Maintain and update CRM/Excel databases for leads, opportunities, meetings and follow-ups.
* Prepare proposals, presentations and documentation for corporate submissions.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth project execution and client onboarding.
* Achieve monthly/quarterly targets for meetings, proposals and closures.
* Build long-term relationships with corporate clients and ensure repeat business.

**SELECTION CRITERIA**

* Proven experience in B2B field sales with a focus on corporate client acquisition.
* Experience in CSR fundraising / corporate sales / corporate partnerships will be a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of the CSR ecosystem and corporate decision-making process.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable with field work and travel.
* Ability to build long-term relationships and manage multiple stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational and follow-up skills.

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Graduate from a recognized university.
* Must have a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in B2B sales.
* Minimum 1.5 years of overall relevant experience in B2B field sales / corporate sales / business development / CSR fundraising / corporate partnerships.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

title: Human Resource Executive [ Night Shift ]
company: Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a responsible, organised, and proactive HR Executive with 1–2 years of experience in recruitment, HR operations, payroll management, and statutory compliance.

The ideal candidate must have practical experience in IT recruitment and hiring Customer Service Representatives (CSR) for international or US-based processes. In addition to recruitment, the candidate should have a good understanding of Indian HR practices, payroll processing, employee documentation, attendance management, and statutory compliance.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment cycle along with day-to-day HR operations, payroll coordination, employee records, and compliance-related activities.

Candidates must be comfortable working night shifts and coordinating with management and employees during US business hours.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and non-IT positions.
* Handle recruitment for Software Developers, .NET Developers, ReactJS Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Database Administrators, and other technical positions.
* Manage hiring for Customer Service Representatives (CSR) and international customer support roles.
* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, employee referrals, and other recruitment platforms.
* Review resumes, shortlist candidates, and conduct initial HR screening interviews.
* Evaluate candidates based on experience, technical knowledge, communication skills, and job requirements.
* Coordinate technical interviews and management rounds.
* Manage candidate follow-ups, interview scheduling, feedback, and offer negotiations.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions.

**2. Payroll Management & Salary Administration**

* Assist in monthly payroll processing and salary preparation.
* Collect, verify, and maintain employee attendance, working hours, late logins, overtime, and leave records.
* Calculate salary components, including Basic Salary, HRA, allowances, deductions, and net payable salary.
* Understand CTC structures, gross salary, in-hand salary, and statutory deductions.
* Calculate and coordinate applicable PF, ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), TDS, and other payroll deductions.
* Prepare monthly payroll sheets and salary statements.
* Coordinate salary revisions, incentives, adjustments, and full-and-final settlements.
* Verify payroll inputs before processing salaries.
* Maintain payroll records and employee salary documentation.
* Coordinate with management, finance teams, or external payroll consultants for timely salary processing.

**3. Indian Labour Laws & Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain a good understanding of applicable Indian Labour Laws and statutory HR compliance requirements.
* Handle employee PF-related activities, including UAN details, PF documentation, and coordination for PF registration and contributions.
* Understand ESIC eligibility, registration, contributions, and related employee documentation.
* Manage Professional Tax (PT) deductions and applicable compliance requirements.
* Understand TDS on salary and coordinate applicable payroll documentation.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, and compliance-related documentation as applicable.
* Assist with gratuity calculations, bonus-related records, and other applicable employee benefits.
* Maintain knowledge of applicable minimum wage, working hours, weekly off, leave, and overtime regulations.
* Coordinate with external consultants and authorities for statutory filings and compliance requirements.
* Ensure employee documentation and HR processes follow applicable employment regulations.

**4. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage employee onboarding, joining formalities, and exit procedures.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.
* Collect and verify employee documents, including identity proofs, educational certificates, and bank details.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR databases.
* Manage employee attendance, leave records, weekly offs, and shift schedules.
* Monitor employee punctuality, late logins, and working-hour completion.
* Coordinate employee confirmations, probation reviews, and performance-related documentation.
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and day-to-day HR-related concerns.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee records.

**5. Employee Engagement & HR Administration**

* Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures, and workplace guidelines.
* Coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations, and internal events.
* Communicate HR announcements, policy updates, and important notices.
* Support employee discipline and workplace administration.
* Coordinate with department heads and management to address employee-related matters.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information, payroll data, and company records.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of practical experience in HR and recruitment.
* Hands-on experience in IT recruitment is mandatory.
* Experience in hiring Customer Service Representatives (CSR) is mandatory.
* Knowledge of Indian payroll processes and statutory compliance is required.
* Good understanding of PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, and applicable labour laws.
* Practical knowledge of attendance management, salary calculations, and payroll preparation.
* Familiarity with employee onboarding, documentation, and exit formalities.
* Working knowledge of Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri, MS Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination, organisational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to maintain confidential employee and payroll information.
* Must be comfortable working night shifts.

Pay: Up to ₹30,000.00 per month

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a mature, business-oriented HR leader to establish and strengthen the people function across Shree Shakti Seva Kendra and Shree Shakti School of Innovation.

The position requires the ability to build practical HR systems, attract and retain capable talent, establish performance-management frameworks and develop an accountable, people-focused organisational culture.

The successful candidate will work closely with leadership to align manpower planning, employee performance, organisational development and HR operations with current requirements and future growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. HR Strategy & Organisation Development

\* Develop and implement an HR roadmap aligned with organisational priorities.

\* Assess workforce requirements and support manpower planning and organisation design.

\* Establish clear roles, reporting structures, job descriptions and accountability frameworks.

\* Develop HR policies, employee handbooks, standard operating procedures and approval processes.

\* Advise leadership on organisational effectiveness, workforce capability and people-related risks.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Lead recruitment planning, sourcing, interviewing, selection and onboarding.

\* Develop structured hiring processes, competency frameworks and candidate assessment methods.

\* Build talent pipelines for leadership, specialist and operational positions.

\* Monitor recruitment timelines, hiring costs, offer acceptance and quality of hire.

\* Establish KRAs, KPIs, appraisal cycles and performance-review processes.

\* Work with managers to set measurable objectives and review employee performance.

\* Identify skill gaps and develop training and capability-building plans.

\* Support career development, succession planning and leadership development where appropriate.

\* Establish a culture of ownership, professional conduct and performance accountability.

4. Employee Engagement & Culture

\* Develop employee-engagement initiatives and structured feedback mechanisms.

\* Establish clear channels for employee concerns, grievance resolution and conflict management.

\* Promote a professional, respectful and inclusive workplace.

\* Strengthen internal communication, recognition and employee-retention practices.

\* Monitor employee satisfaction, attrition patterns and recurring workplace concerns.

5. HR Operations, Governance & Compliance

\* Oversee employee documentation, HR records, attendance, leave and payroll coordination.

\* Ensure appropriate processes for employment contracts, confirmations, exits and full-and-final settlements.

\* Coordinate statutory compliance and employment-law matters with qualified specialists where required.

\* Maintain confidentiality and appropriate controls over employee information.

\* Develop HR dashboards and periodic management reports.

6. Leadership Partnership & Future Scalability

\* Act as a trusted HR partner to leadership on people-related decisions.

\* Provide evidence-based recommendations on workforce structure, productivity and talent requirements.

\* Establish processes that can scale with organisational growth.

\* Subject to future business requirements and approval, contribute to the development of a shared in-house HR function supporting the wider DA Group.

\* Master’s degree or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Organisational Development or a related discipline preferred.

\* 10–15 years of progressive HR experience, including senior-level ownership of HR operations and people strategy.

\* Demonstrated experience implementing HR systems, performance frameworks and recruitment processes.

\* Strong understanding of applicable Indian employment and labour-law requirements.

\* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.

\* Ability to work directly with senior leadership and manage sensitive employee matters with discretion.

\* Experience implementing HR technology, reporting dashboards and process improvements is preferred.

Experience in education, healthcare, NGOs, multi-location organisations or diversified business groups will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Recruitment effectiveness, time to hire, employee retention, performance-review completion, employee engagement, HR process compliance, policy implementation and workforce-planning effectiveness.

An opportunity to build a robust people function, influence organisational culture and establish scalable HR practices as the organisations grow

* Run hiring end to end for office, sales, warehouse and site roles: post jobs, screen CVs, schedule and conduct first-round interviews, and run reference checks.
* Coordinate practical tests and final interviews with team heads, and keep a live tracker for every open role.
* Prepare offer and appointment letters, collect joining documents, and run a structured first-week induction.

**Records, attendance and payroll inputs**

* Maintain complete employee files — KYC, documents, signed policies — and issue HR letters: confirmation, increment, experience and relieving.
* Track attendance and leave, and share verified payroll inputs with Accounts every month.
* Support the appraisal and salary revision cycle with attendance and performance data.

**Statutory compliance**

* Handle PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund: employee registrations, monthly returns and on-time payments with Accounts.
* Maintain statutory registers and licences, and keep our practices in line with the new Labour Codes.
* Coordinate POSH compliance: Internal Committee records, awareness sessions and the annual report.

**Employee relations and exits**

* Be the first point of contact for employee queries on policies, leave and benefits.
* Roll out HR policy updates, keep signed acknowledgements on file, and plan festival celebrations and team events.
* Run exit formalities — handover, asset recovery, exit interview — and close full-and-final inputs within the Labour Code timeline.

**Office administration**

* Run the office day to day: housekeeping, pantry, stationery, courier and printing.
* Manage facility vendors and maintenance contracts — AC, internet, CCTV and electrical — for the office and godowns.
* Issue and recover company assets: laptops, phones, SIM cards and ID cards.
* Track rent agreements, insurance and licence renewals, and book travel for outstation visits.

**Reporting**

* Share a monthly HR report: headcount, joinings, exits, attendance and open positions.

What we're looking for

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, business or a related field.
* 2–5 years in HR and administration, ideally in a company of 25–200 people where you handled the full employee lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with PF, ESIC and Professional Tax portals and monthly payroll inputs.
* Experience hiring for both office roles and warehouse or site staff.
* Good MS Office: Excel (XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, pivot tables) and letter drafting in Word.
* Fluent Gujarati and Hindi; good written English for letters and email.
* Attention to detail and complete discretion with confidential data.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Labour Codes and POSH compliance.
* Experience with HRMS or attendance software.

**You'll do well here if you**

* Close every loop: each candidate, query and document gets a response.
* Stay calm and fair in sensitive conversations.
* Build simple systems and checklists instead of relying on memory.
* Keep records audit-ready without reminders.

How to apply

Send your CV to **krutish@hrishalightings.com** with the subject "HR & Admin Executive – Your Name".

title: HR Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**HR EXECUTIVE**

**Position**

HR Executive

**Reports to**

Managing Partner (functionally also to the Head of Operations)

**Location**

Head Office, Ahmedabad — with regular travel to project sites and asphalt plants

**Experience**

3–6 years in HR / personnel / labour compliance, preferably with a construction, infrastructure or manufacturing company

**Qualification**

Graduate in any discipline; MBA/MSW/PGDM in HR or a Diploma in Labour Law an advantage

**CTC**

₹ 2,40,000 – ₹ 4,20,000 per annum (₹ 20,000 – ₹ 35,000 per month), based on experience

**Employment**

Full time, on the rolls of Saurabh Builders

**About us**

Saurabh Builders is an AA-class registered Gujarat government infrastructure contractor based in Ahmedabad, executing bituminous road, RCC and structural works for Gujarat R&B, GIDC, AMC, VMC and other departments. We operate asphalt batch mix plants at Dhansura (Arvalli), Vadodara and Valsad, an AMC Division at Ahmedabad, and a fleet of over 54 commercial vehicles and construction machines. The group also includes a sister entity, Propave Infra LLP.

**Purpose of the role**

This is the company's first dedicated HR position. Hiring, joining paperwork, statutory records and site labour compliance are presently handled by the management alongside everything else. You will take complete ownership of the employee life cycle — from hiring to exit — and of every statutory register, return and record that a labour inspector, PF officer or departmental auditor can ask for.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment and onboarding**

* Source and screen candidates for site and office positions — site engineers, supervisors, plant operators, surveyors, billing and accounts staff, drivers and operators — through job portals, consultants, referrals and local networks.
* Coordinate interviews, carry out reference checks with the last two employers of every candidate, and verify qualification and experience certificates before any offer is issued.
* Issue appointment letters, collect signed acceptances, and complete the full joining documentation set — joining form, document checklist, confidentiality undertaking, PPE issue, site cash advance undertaking and induction checklist.
* Maintain the onboarding tracker as the single source of truth, and report pending items for every employee without being asked.

**2. Statutory compliance and records**

* EPFO: UAN generation and linking within 30 days of joining, Form 11 and Form 2, monthly ECR preparation and payment by the 15th, exit date marking, and resolution of member grievances.
* Professional Tax: monthly deduction, remittance and returns under the Gujarat Act; ESIC registration and monthly contribution wherever an employee falls within the wage ceiling.
* Maintenance of wage registers, muster rolls, overtime, leave and attendance records, site-wise, in the formats required under the Code on Wages, 2019 and the OSH&WC Code.
* Compliance under the BOCW Act and the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act for our sites — registrations, licences, returns, and verification of sub-contractor compliance.
* Preparation for and handling of labour, PF and departmental inspections, including production of any document within five minutes of being asked.
* Tracking of the statutory calendar and advance warning of every due date to the management.

**3. Payroll inputs and attendance**

* Collect and verify attendance from all sites and plants every month, including overtime, leave without pay and site allowances, and issue clean payroll inputs to accounts by the agreed cut-off.
* Prepare salary structures for new hires on the company CTC calculator, keeping Basic at or above 50% of CTC and checking the ESI position at every revision.
* Coordinate TDS declarations and investment proofs with the accounts team, and resolve salary and PF queries of employees.

**4. Site labour and contractor management**

* Verify the labour strength deployed by sub-contractors at each site against their bills, and check their PF, ESI and wage compliance before certification.
* Ensure every worker at site holds valid identity records, has been given PPE, and has received the safety induction before entering a live carriageway.
* Handle site-level grievances, discipline, show-cause notices and warning letters in consultation with the management.

**5. Records, systems and reporting**

* Maintain one complete folder per employee — KYC, statutory forms, correspondence — scanned within the week a document is signed.
* Run the probation review cycle: Day 7, Day 30 and the six-month confirmation decision, with written outcomes.
* Process exits — resignation, notice period, handover and clearance, PF exit marking and full and final settlement.
* Report monthly to the management on headcount, joinings and exits, attrition, statutory status and open compliance items.

**What we are looking for**

* Working, hands-on knowledge of the EPFO employer portal, the Gujarat professional tax system and ESIC — not theory, you should have filed these yourself.
* Practical understanding of the Code on Wages 2019, the OSH&WC Code, BOCW and CLRA as they apply to a government works contractor.
* Experience maintaining wage registers and muster rolls for multiple sites, and facing at least one labour or PF inspection.
* Strong Excel — this company runs on trackers and registers, not on expensive software.
* Fluent Gujarati and Hindi, and workable written English for letters and departmental correspondence. Many of our site staff read only Hindi, so documents must be explained to them in their own language.
* Willingness to travel to sites and plants at Dhansura, Vadodara, Valsad and within Ahmedabad.
* A person who tells the management what is pending and what is overdue, rather than letting it pass quietly.

**Good to have**

* Experience with a contractor registered with Gujarat R&B, AMC, GIDC, NHAI or a similar authority.
* Exposure to payroll software (Zoho People, Keka, GreytHR) and to digital attendance at site.
* Experience drafting bilingual (English–Gujarati or English–Hindi) forms and notices.

**What success looks like in the first 90 days**

* Every employee on the rolls has a complete, signed document file and a UAN linked within the statutory time limit.
* The PF, PT and ESI calendar runs without a single late payment or return.
* Wage registers and muster rolls are current and site-wise, and can be produced on demand.
* Open positions are filled within an agreed time, with reference checks done before the offer.
* The management is told, every month, exactly what is pending and what is coming due.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
